vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: devops-journey
Version: 2.0.2

The skill bundle is a documentation reference tool that provides static text information about DevOps concepts. The primary script (scripts/script.sh) only uses heredocs to output plain-text documentation and contains no network calls, file system modifications, or credential access.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent: it only provides static reference text, requires no credentials or network access, and the included shell script simply prints documentation.

dimensions.detail: Name/description promise reference documentation; required resources are none and the included script only emits static heredoc content that matches the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to output plain-text references with no external calls; the provided script implements only local text output and does not read files, environment variables, or make network requests.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope

llm.guidance: This skill appears low-risk: it prints static DevOps reference text and requires no credentials or network access. You can safely install it if you only need offline documentation delivered by the agent. As a best practice, verify you trust the publisher (BytesAgain) and confirm how your agent runtime executes bundled scripts (they should run with normal user privileges). Note: the bundled script contains a harmless template bug (the help text shows the literal "$VERSION" instead of the actual version), which is an implementation issue but not a security concern.
